engine_semantics: Applied in-memory at RuleGraph.load time. verified_rules.json is never modified; canonical rule ids, human_verification records, and the store fingerprint (9cc91ac7...) are untouched. Evaluation results carry params_source=caddy_extraction_v1 in their reason.
extraction_provenance: Machine-extracted by Caddy's extraction worker (2026-09-24) from the Rohan-verified rule quotes in rulegraph/verified_rules.json; cross-checked against the canonical store by the LeBron sync worker 2026-09-24 02:12 MDT (no discrepancies). HUMAN VERIFICATION COVERS THE RULE QUOTES, NOT THIS PARAM EXTRACTION. Gaps recorded by the extraction stay gaps (UNKNOWN) — never zeros or defaults.

not_executable.M-1-06: qualitative (Chapter 21A.48 landscape conformance); no numeric parameter in quote -> no evaluator, stays UNKNOWN
not_executable.OS-05: qualitative (Chapter 21A.48 landscaped yards); no numeric parameter in quote -> no evaluator, stays UNKNOWN

params.existing_conforming_note: Lots legally existing as of 1995-04-12 are legal conforming lots even below the minima (21A.28.020.C.3). Per-lot existing status is not in the pipeline context: a below-minimum lot with unknown existing status yields UNKNOWN, never FAIL.

params.landscape_buffer_gap: the setback is measured beyond the 21A.48.080 landscape buffer whose numeric depth is not stated in the stored quote; with height above 30 ft and abutment confirmed, the required total setback cannot be computed -> UNKNOWN

params.distillation_note: emission-free distillation column structures necessary for manufacture processing: up to the most restrictive FAA-imposed minimal approach surface elevation, or 120 ft maximum, whichever is less

params.exception_condition: subject to the design review standards and procedures of chapter 21A.59
params.exception_zone: west of Salt Lake City International Airport and north of I-80

params.public_utilities_exemption: building/structure heights for the Salt Lake City Public Utilities Department not specifically exempt in 21A.02.050 are exempt from the district height restrictions

params.applies_to: recreation equipment when needed due to the nature of the equipment or for the use to operate safely (e.g. fences surrounding golf course driving ranges); separate from building height

yard_inflation_from_os02.note: per 21A.32.100.D via OS-02: for each foot of height over the tier threshold, each required yard and landscaped yard increases one foot; consumed jointly per the extraction notes

params.use_note: row selection requires the proposed use; unknown use -> UNKNOWN, never the more permissive row

params.abutting_greater_height_gap: where abutting a district allowing greater height, the abutting district's standard applies; that numeric value is not stated in the quote and must be looked up per adjacent district -> UNKNOWN when the exception could apply

params.abutment_note: interior/rear yards branch on whether the abutting district is residential/manufacturing vs other; unmapped zone codes -> UNKNOWN

k12_public.perimeter_note: on multi-parcel school sites setbacks apply to the site perimeter and to property lines shared with a different owner

params.zone_prefix_note: residential/manufacturing by prefix (M- with hyphen, so MU-* never matches manufacturing); 'other' only for explicitly listed known SLC districts; anything else -> UNKNOWN, never guessed.
